snippet.title: Michael Jackson Wanted to bring Love and Joy
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson Wanted to bring Love and Joy Greek subtitles

"No matter how good your intentions are,there is always some jerk,some mean spirited person,they try to bring you down and all you want to do is to give some love and some joy"

So everydody don't give up don't believe the crap from anybody.

snippet.title: Tabloid Junkie~❤~Michael Jackson
snippet.description:
"I am bewildered at the length to which people will go to portray me so negatively.No matter how good your intentions are, there´s always some jerk, some mean spirited person who tries to bring you down. And all you wanted to do was to bring some love and some joy. And they´re so quick to hate and to judge and be cruel and mean. It just shows that man-kind can be very ugly and cruel, it really does. It brings out the ugly side. "
~❤~Michael Jackson

snippet.title: Michael Jackson quotes - No matter what you do
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson quote:
"No matter what you do, no matter how good your intentions are, there's always some jerk, some mean spirited person that try to bring me down... and all you wanted to do is bring some love and some joy... that's all".

Always the King... thanks for watching :-)
